# LOG-005: The journal survives a reboot

- **Group:** Logs and monitoring
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

A volatile journal lives in /run and is erased at every reboot, including the reboot after a compromise or a crash, which is when the logs are needed. Persistent when Storage=persistent or Storage=auto with /var/log/journal present.

## Verify by hand

```sh
systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/journald.conf; ls -d /var/log/journal
```

## How to fix it

Create /var/log/journal (or set Storage=persistent in a drop-in) and restart systemd-journald.

## What a fix can break

Logs then use disk space; set a cap (LOG-001).

Run `stackward explain LOG-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
